e23664fbe4a05bc0.description: Job description About the role We are looking for an experienced Road Civil 3D Coordinator to join our team on a major infrastructure project in Qiddiya, Saudi Arabia . Working within the project’s design and engineering team, you will be responsible for coordinating Civil 3D road design activities , ensuring consistency and quality across models, drawings and deliverables, and supporting effective collaboration between the different engineering disciplines and project stakeholders. This position is particularly suited to a technically strong Civil 3D professional who combines hands-on modelling expertise with the ability to coordinate multidisciplinary road and infrastructure design activities. Key ResponsibilitiesCivil 3D Coordination Coordinate the production and integration of Civil 3D models for roads and associated infrastructure . Ensure consistency between alignments, profiles, corridors, surfaces, assemblies and related design information. Review Civil 3D models and drawings to identify clashes, inconsistencies and coordination issues. Ensure compliance with project modelling standards, naming conventions and agreed workflows. Support engineers and designers in resolving complex Civil 3D modelling issues. Monitor the quality and consistency of Civil 3D deliverables throughout the design process. Road Design & Multidisciplinary Coordination Coordinate road design interfaces with earthworks, utilities, drainage, structures, landscape and other infrastructure disciplines . Ensure that road geometry and levels are properly coordinated with surrounding infrastructure. Participate in multidisciplinary design reviews and technical coordination meetings. Identify design interfaces and potential conflicts at an early stage and coordinate their resolution with the relevant teams. Support the integration of design changes into the Civil 3D environment. BIM & Digital Delivery Work closely with BIM and design coordination teams to ensure effective integration of Civil 3D models within the wider project digital environment. Contribute to model reviews and coordination processes. Maintain high standards of model quality, accuracy and data consistency. Support the development and implementation of Civil 3D best practices across the project team. Project Delivery Coordinate with designers, engineers, BIM teams, contractors and other project stakeholders. Support the preparation and review of technical deliverables at key project milestones. Track technical issues related to road modelling and coordinate their resolution. Contribute to continuous improvement of design and modelling workflows. Candidate ProfileEducation Degree or technical qualification in Civil Engineering, Roads, Infrastructure Engineering or a related discipline. Experience Significant professional experience in road and infrastructure design . Strong hands-on experience with Autodesk Civil 3D , ideally on large and complex infrastructure projects. Experience coordinating Civil 3D production across multidisciplinary design teams. Previous experience on major international infrastructure, urban development or transport projects would be highly valued. Experience in Saudi Arabia or the Middle East would be an advantage. Technical Skills Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Civil 3D . Strong knowledge of: Road alignments and profiles Corridors and assemblies Digital terrain models and surfaces Grading and earthworks Cross-sections Road interfaces with drainage and utilities Model and drawing production Good understanding of BIM coordination and multidisciplinary modelling workflows . Knowledge of Autodesk Construction Cloud / BIM 360, Navisworks and AutoCAD would be an advantage. Personal Skills Strong technical coordination and problem-solving capabilities. Ability to work effectively within a large multidisciplinary and multicultural project environment. Excellent attention to detail and commitment to design quality. Ability to manage multiple interfaces and priorities. Strong communication and coordination skills. Proactive and collaborative mindset. Professional proficiency in English . Why Join Us? This position offers the opportunity to contribute to a major and technically challenging infrastructure project in Saudi Arabia , working in an international engineering and construction environment. You will play a key role in ensuring the quality and coordination of road design models while collaborating with multidisciplinary teams on a highly visible project. Location: Riyadh / Qiddiya, Saudi Arabia Discipline: Roads & Infrastructure Position: Road Civil 3D Coordinator Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

e276c3e98c7e5dd1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة فيلورا نيلز سبا عن مدير إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في تبوك. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف العام على الأنشطة الإدارية، بما يضمن توافقها مع الخطط التشغيلية المعتمدة وتوفير الموارد اللازمة لسير العمليات اليومية بكفاءة وفعالية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في تحديد الأهداف الرئيسية للشؤون الإدارية وتطوير وتنفيذ الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات لتحقيقها. الإشراف على تطوير ومراجعة جداول الصلاحيات والإجراءات الإدارية لتحسين جودة وسرعة الخدمات. متابعة وتوجيه أنشطة تلبية احتياجات الوحدات التنظيمية والموظفين من الخدمات الإدارية المتنوعة مثل النقل، الضيافة، النظافة، تنظيم المراسلات، والأرشفة. الإشراف على تطبيق الأنظمة والتعليمات والقرارات الإدارية، وضمان إبلاغ جميع الوحدات والموظفين بها ومتابعة تنفيذها. الإشراف على إعداد الملخصات والتقارير الدورية حول نسب الإنجاز في الشؤون الإدارية وتقديمها للإدارة العليا، مع إطلاعهم على التحديات والمستجدات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الإدارة أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على تخطيط وتنظيم الأعمال الإدارية بكفاءة. فهم جيد للعمليات الإدارية ومتطلباتها. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية وتخطيطية ممتازة. القدرة على الإشراف وتوجيه الفرق. مهارات تواصل فعالة. القدرة على إعداد التقارير وتقديمها للإدارة العليا. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في تبوك، المملكة العربية السعودية. يتطلب الدور العمل ضمن فريق إداري لضمان سير العمليات اليومية بسلاسة وفعالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

e2cde2ce67daf385.description: About the Role J&T Express is seeking an Operations Manager to lead and optimize end-to-end express delivery and hub operations in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves ensuring seamless first-mile, sorting, transportation, and last-mile operations while driving service efficiency, maintaining safety compliance, and meeting operational KPIs. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Manage end-to-end logistics operations, including pickup, sorting, transportation, and last-mile parcel delivery. Monitor daily branch/hub activities to ensure operational targets and service level agreements (SLAs) are met consistently. Plan and optimize delivery routes and driver dispatch schedules to reduce transit times and operational costs. Performance and KPI Tracking Track and report on key operational metrics, such as On-Time Delivery (OTD), delivery success rate, and cost-per-parcel. Drive process improvement initiatives to reduce parcel damage, missing rates, and customer complaints. Conduct regular reviews of operational efficiency and present reports to senior management. e2eb3f366382487f.description: About Us Tamara is the leading shopping and payments platform in Saudi Arabia and the GCC region, with a mission to empower people in their daily lives and revolutionize how they shop, pay, and bank. The company was founded by serial entrepreneur Abdulmajeed Alsukhan along with his partners Turki Bin Zarah and Abdulmohsen Al Babtain. Tamara operates out of its headquarters in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and has offices in the UAE, Egypt, Germany, and Vietnam. Our large, dedicated team of professionals continues to grow as we expand our reach and impact. Serving millions of users and partnering with thousands of merchants, Tamara collaborates with leading global and regional brands such as SHEIN, Jarir, noon, IKEA, H&M, and Farfetch, as well as local small and medium businesses. The company is backed by SNB Capital and Sanabil Investments, a wholly-owned company by the Public Investment Fund (PIF), Checkout.com, Coatue, Shorooq Partners, and Endeavor Catalyst, among others. Your role We are looking for a Senior Compliance Associate to support the Compliance Department in ensuring full adherence to SAMA regulations applicable to payment services, including activities under the Electronic Money Institution (EMI) license and other Payment Service Provider (PSP) categories. The role involves both advisory and monitoring responsibilities to ensure ongoing regulatory compliance. You are a driven, determined, curious team player, knowing that collective strength means we all win. With a positive outlook, you are solution-oriented–persevering regardless of circumstances, always finding a way through, no matter the challenges. You will effectively find a way to work with everyone through empathy and respect. You will be driven and comfortable with responding quickly with urgency, with the ability to change course without losing momentum and energy, resulting in great success. Your responsibilities Ensure compliance with all applicable SAMA regulations related to payment services (e.g., EMI, PSP, wallet providers). Review and approve new products to ensure alignment with SAMA requirements. Monitor internal processes and product structures for regulatory adherence. Track, interpret, and implement changes from SAMA circulars and regulatory updates. Review and maintain internal policies and procedures to ensure consistency with current SAMA regulations. Ensure receipt and proper dissemination of all circulars and publications issued by SAMA; follow up with relevant departments to ensure timely implementation. Prepare and submit accurate regulatory reports to SAMA within required timelines. Review management reports submitted to SAMA for accuracy and completeness. Coordinate with internal teams to collect and validate data required by SAMA. Support regulatory inspections, audits, and remediation actions as needed. Provide advisory support to internal stakeholders on payment-related compliance matters. Your expertise Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business, Finance, or a related field. Minimum 3-5 years of experience in a compliance role at a SAMA-regulated entity operating in the payments sector. Solid understanding of SAMA’s regulatory framework for payment services. Experience in regulatory reporting and policy review. Fluent in English and Arabic (spoken and written). Strong communication, coordination, and analytical skills. Detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities effectively.Fluency in English and Arabic.

Develop new ERP modules based on company needs, starting with high-priority business requirements. Improve existing functionalities, workflows, and system performance. Design and implement database structures that support reliable data management and future growth. Develop and maintain APIs and integrations with internal and third-party systems. e228b0352429495d.description: About the Role: Inventory Planner Caterpillar Inc. is seeking an experienced Inventory Planner to join the SPM Oil & Gas parts business. This full-time role is critical for ensuring optimal inventory availability, minimizing stock shortages, and enhancing overall inventory control to support revenue generation and customer satisfaction. The position requires 4 years of relevant experience. Role Context and Impact The Inventory Planner will be responsible for inventory planning, forecasting, demand management, stock optimization, and ERP-driven inventory control across multiple customer and operational sites. Success in this role will lead to improved inventory visibility, reduced stock-outs, enhanced forecast accuracy, and increased parts availability to meet customer demand and support revenue growth. The role involves close collaboration with sales, operations, supply chain, and customer-facing teams. Key Responsibilities Manage inventory levels to ensure optimal stock availability while minimizing excess inventory. Monitor, analyze, and maintain inventory accuracy using ERP systems. Support parts sales activities by ensuring timely availability of critical SPM Oil & Gas components. Develop and maintain forecasting and demand planning models to support business requirements. Identify stock shortages, excess inventory, and supply risks, implementing corrective actions as required. Generate inventory reports and provide recommendations to improve stock control and inventory performance. Coordinate with supply chain, procurement, warehousing, and operations teams for efficient inventory replenishment. Investigate inventory discrepancies and drive root cause analyses to prevent recurrence. Ensure compliance with internal inventory control procedures and best practices. Communicate inventory status, risks, and recommendations to key stakeholders. Travel to multiple customer and operational sites as required. Required Experience Minimum 4 years of experience in inventory planning or a related field. Demonstrated experience with inventory planning, forecasting, and demand management. Proficiency in ERP systems for inventory control and data management. Ability to collaborate effectively with sales, operations, and supply chain teams. About Caterpillar Caterpillar Inc. is a global manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines, and diesel-electric locomotives. For 100 years, Caterpillar has supported customers in building a more sustainable world and is committed to a reduced-carbon future. The company operates across every continent through its primary segments: Construction Industries, Resource Industries, and Energy & Transportation, with financing services provided by its Financial Products segment.

e2c8c6c6ae5d184c.description: Job description Empowering Progress Through Integrated Supply Chain & Logistics Solutions Red Sea Coastal Trading Company is a specialized supply chain and logistics subsidiary under Red Sea Global, designed to power the seamless delivery of materials, equipment, and services across our portfolio of pioneering developments. Operating at the heart of Saudi Arabia’s most ambitious regenerative tourism projects, the subsidiary delivers end-to-end supply chain management, including procurement support, transportation coordination, inventory and warehouse management, and last-mile logistics to remote destinations across the Red Sea coast and beyond. With a focus on efficiency, reliability, and environmental responsibility, the team ensures that every link in the supply chain supports Red Sea Global’s commitment to sustainability, operational excellence, and local value creation. Efficiency in Motion. Excellence in Delivery. Job Purpose: Lead the purchasing function under the direction of the Senior Director – Strategic Procurement & Category Management, translating enterprise category strategies into effective sourcing, supplier management, and purchasing execution across food and beverage, OS&E, consumables, services, and other assigned categories. The role supports cost optimization, supply continuity, quality improvement, supplier performance, risk mitigation, and governance by partnering closely with operations, finance, legal, commercial, and functional stakeholders to deliver measurable value and reliable service to the business. Job Responsibilities: Support the Senior Director in implementing the centralized purchasing and category management strategy aligned with business priorities, growth plans, and operating requirements. Translate approved category strategies into sourcing plans, supplier actions, contract initiatives, and purchasing activities across assigned spend areas. Lead purchasing execution for food and beverage, OS&E, consumables, services, and other assigned categories, ensuring cost-effective, compliant, and timely delivery to operations. Conduct spend analysis, demand reviews, market research, supplier assessments, and opportunity identification to support category plans and sourcing decisions. Lead RFx, tendering, evaluation, negotiation, and supplier selection processes within delegated authority, ensuring transparency, competitiveness, and commercial value. Prepare sourcing recommendations, commercial evaluations, and contract award justifications for senior management review and approval. Manage supplier relationships and performance reviews for assigned suppliers, monitoring cost, service, quality, lead time, responsiveness, compliance, and sustainability performance. Work with internal stakeholders to challenge demand, clarify specifications, consolidate requirements, and promote standardization and approved buying channels. Support supplier segmentation, development, rationalization, corrective action, and continuous improvement initiatives in line with the wider procurement strategy. Identify and escalate supply, commercial, operational, contractual, and compliance risks, and support mitigation plans to protect service continuity and business value. Ensure adherence to procurement policies, approval matrices, delegation of authority, ethical sourcing standards, supplier onboarding requirements, and documentation controls. Maintain procurement reports and dashboards covering savings, cost avoidance, contract coverage, supplier performance, compliance, working capital, and risk indicators. Provide guidance, coaching, and day-to-day direction to purchasing team members to strengthen commercial capability, accountability, service quality, and continuous improvement. Qualification and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field. MBA, master’s degree, or professional certification such as CIPS, CPSM, CSCP, ISM, or equivalent is preferred. 10–15+ years of progressive experience in purchasing, procurement, strategic sourcing, category management. Proven experience managing sourcing events, supplier negotiations, contract implementation, and supplier performance within a complex operational environment. Experience supporting or leading category plans across food and beverage, OS&E, consumables, services, trading, distribution, FMCG, hospitality, retail, or similarly complex commercial environments. Strong track record in delivering savings, cost avoidance, service improvements, compliance, and supplier performance outcomes. Preferred candidate Years of experience 1+ years Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

e22337eae995a79c.description: About the Role Duncan & Ross is seeking an experienced Hull Structure Designer (Construction Support – CS) to join our team in Ras Tannurah. This full-time role involves providing essential technical and design support to shipyard production teams, focusing on hull structure activities within marine and shipbuilding projects. The successful candidate will be responsible for resolving design issues, updating structural documentation, and ensuring compliance with project specifications and marine standards. Key Responsibilities Provide construction and production support for hull structure activities in marine and shipbuilding projects. Review, update, and revise hull structure design deliverables, including structural arrangement, construction, shell plating, deck, bulkhead, longitudinal, and transverse framing drawings. Develop stiffener, bracket, structural connection details, foundations, reinforcements, and supporting arrangements. Prepare block assembly, fabrication, and erection drawings, along with 2D structural drawings and 3D hull structure models. Review shop drawings and production information to identify discrepancies and resolve structural design-related issues. Provide technical support to shipyard production teams during hull fabrication, assembly, erection, and installation. Resolve technical queries (TQs), structural discrepancies, production issues, and fabrication-related design problems. Incorporate engineering changes, production feedback, and redline mark-ups into structural drawings and 3D models. Coordinate with Naval Architecture, Machinery Outfitting, Piping, HVAC, Electrical, and other engineering disciplines to ensure proper design integration and avoid clashes. Verify structural member arrangements, plate thicknesses, stiffener details, brackets, and connections against approved design documentation. Ensure hull structure drawings comply with project specifications, applicable classification society rules, marine standards, and shipyard construction requirements. Participate in constructability reviews to identify potential structural conflicts, fabrication constraints, and assembly difficulties. Review production feedback and recommend appropriate structural modifications to facilitate fabrication, assembly, and erection. Maintain updated structural drawings, technical records, and documentation in accordance with project procedures. Support as-built drawing updates and incorporate final fabrication and production modifications as required. Ensure construction support design deliverables are completed within agreed project schedules and quality requirements. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in marine and shipbuilding projects. Demonstrated experience in hull structure design and construction support. Proficiency in reviewing, updating, and revising structural design deliverables. Familiarity with classification society rules, marine standards, and shipyard construction requirements. Skills and Attributes Strong technical and design skills related to hull structures. Ability to identify and resolve structural design-related issues efficiently. Effective coordination and communication skills for inter-disciplinary collaboration. Attention to detail to ensure structural accuracy and constructability. Work Type This is a full-time position. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

e271999f77e6056b.description: Company Description Amana Light, part of RWAZEN Group, is an established provider of comprehensive indoor and outdoor lighting solutions in the Saudi market, operating from its main branch in Riyadh. The company specializes in end-to-end lighting systems, offering products and services tailored to each client’s functional and aesthetic needs. Amana Light focuses on delivering high-quality, reliable, and innovative lighting solutions that enhance built environments and user experiences. Its client-centered approach emphasizes thoughtful design, technical excellence, and long-term service relationships. Day-to-day tasks include creating detailed lighting plans, specifying fixtures and control systems, producing technical drawings and documentation, and coordinating with architects, interior designers, engineers, and project managers. The role involves reviewing project requirements, conducting lighting calculations and simulations, preparing presentations and visualizations, and providing guidance to junior designers. The Senior Lighting Designer will also participate in design reviews, support client meetings, and contribute to continuous improvement of design standards and best practices. This is a full-time remote role. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong skills in Lighting Design and Architectural Lighting. Candidates should possess practical experience in Lighting Control and overall Lighting systems. e2ee498c0ba4c5e2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة وجد الحياة للتجارة عن فني أجهزة طبية للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة الباحة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على متابعة تركيب وتشغيل وصيانة الأجهزة الطبية، بما يضمن الأداء الفعال والموثوق لهذه المعدات الحيوية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمهنيين الطموحين في بداية مسيرتهم المهنية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة مخططات تركيب الأجهزة الطبية المتنوعة مثل أجهزة غسل الكلى، وأجهزة دعم القلب والتنفس والرئة، وأجهزة التصوير والتخطيط الطبي. تحديد مواقع التركيب ومتابعة إجراءات التثبيت، بالإضافة إلى إعداد قوائم بقطع الغيار الاحتياطية الضرورية. متابعة إجراءات التشغيل التجريبي للأجهزة الطبية والتأكد من تشغيلها وفقًا لأدلة التشغيل المحددة. تدريب مستخدمي الأجهزة الطبية على إجراءات التشغيل السليم والضبط الصحيح لضمان الاستخدام الأمثل. تتبع مخططات الدارات الإلكترونية للأجهزة الطبية، وتشخيص الأعطال باستخدام أجهزة الفحص والقياس المتخصصة، وتنفيذ إجراءات الإصلاح والضبط اللازمة. تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة الطبية بما يتوافق مع تعليمات الشركة المصنعة لضمان استمرارية الأداء. إعداد وتقديم وتوثيق وحفظ تقارير العمل بشكل دوري ومنظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال صيانة وتركيب الأجهزة الطبية. القدرة على قراءة وتتبع المخططات الفنية والكهربائية للأجهزة الطبية. مهارات تشخيص الأعطال وإجراء الإصلاحات اللازمة بكفاءة. الالتزام بتعليمات الشركات المصنعة وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الباحة، وستكون جزءًا من فريق متخصص يعمل على دعم البنية التحتية للأجهزة الطبية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب الالتزام بجدول عمل منتظم لضمان استمرارية الخدمات. فرصة النمو توفر هذه الوظيفة فرصة ممتازة للمهنيين الجدد لاكتساب خبرة قيمة في مجال الأجهزة الطبية، وتطوير مهاراتهم في بيئة عمل داعمة ومتطورة. سيتمكن الفني من العمل مع مجموعة واسعة من الأجهزة والتقنيات الحديثة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة الخطوات التالية في عملية التوظيف.

e2573d5def608bc2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل عن فني صيانة أجهزة إلكترونية للانضمام إلى فريقها في محايل، عسير. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. سيقوم شاغل الوظيفة بتتبع الأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية، وتشخيص الأعطال، ومتابعة أنشطة الصيانة الوقائية والتصحيحية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تتبع المخططات الإلكترونية للمنظومات والتمديدات والأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية لتحديد إجراءات تشخيص الأعطال. تشخيص أعطال المنظومات والتمديدات والأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية بدقة. تقدير كمية وتكلفة مواد ومستلزمات الصيانة اللازمة ومتابعة توفيرها. متابعة إجراءات إصلاح الأعطال وفحص الأجهزة والمعدات بعد الإصلاح لضمان دقة أدائها وضبطها. متابعة تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للمنظومات والتمديدات والأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية وفقاً للخطط المحددة. إعداد وتقديم وتوثيق وحفظ تقارير العمل بشكل دوري. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في صيانة الأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية. القدرة على قراءة وتتبع المخططات الإلكترونية. مهارات قوية في تشخيص الأعطال وتحديد أسبابها. القدرة على تقدير التكاليف والمواد اللازمة للصيانة. بيئة العمل يعمل فني صيانة الأجهزة الإلكترونية ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل، ويقع مقر العمل في مدينة محايل بمنطقة عسير. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام ببرامج الصيانة المجدولة. معلومات إضافية تُعد هذه الفرصة مناسبة للمهنيين الذين يمتلكون خبرة في صيانة الأجهزة الإلكترونية ويسعون للانضمام إلى بيئة عمل ديناميكية. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

e27051e690056ce4.description: About Red Sea Global and Botanica Red Sea Global is a visionary developer focused on sustainability and innovation. Botanica, a subsidiary of Red Sea Global, specializes in providing sustainable greenery solutions across Red Sea Global’s destinations, ensuring the careful integration of new species with local flora. Botanica operates a 1 million square meter facility and has cultivated over 5 million plants since 2020, with a target of 30 million by 2030, contributing to the natural landscapes of The Red Sea & Amaala. The team includes 40% local community members and is committed to ecological harmony. Role Overview The Director Production will lead plant production at Botanica Red Sea, overseeing the growth and supply of plant material from the 180-hectare nursery. This full-time role, based in Tabuk (Umluj, Tabuk), is responsible for an annual production capacity of 8 million plants, including propagation, greenhouses, shade houses, flowers, indoor plants, the seed bank, and the native species program. The Director will also lead R&D and biosecurity initiatives. This position is accountable for plant quality, availability, biosecurity, safety, and production cost, ensuring supply aligns with commercial sales for both internal Red Sea Global clients and external developments. Key Responsibilities Translate approved demand plans into production, import, and growing plans with the PMO. Achieve production volumes, plant readiness dates, germination, and survival targets, while managing live plant inventory with accurate stock records. Review plant Bills of Quantities (BOQs) for all projects, confirming availability, substitutions, and lead times. Lead plant propagation, greenhouse and shade house operations, flower and food production, indoor plants, and the seed bank. Grow the native plant program and increase the share of native production. Apply crop management practices, including scheduling, fertilization, and Integrated Pest Management (IPM). Own the Biosecurity Protocol, covering inspection of incoming and imported material, phytosanitary documentation, quarantine, hygiene, and traceability. Lead the IPM program and the R&D roadmap for propagation techniques, substrates, irrigation, and climate-resilient species. Ensure compliance with MEWA requirements and the use of approved species only. Manage the direct cost budget for nursery production and R&D, controlling expenses for labor, materials, water, fuel, equipment, and wastage. Plan manpower, equipment, and materials with the PMO, reporting utilization and productivity weekly. Identify and report cost and delivery risks early, proposing corrective actions. Lead managers, supervisors, horticulturists, and operatives, driving competency, training, and supervision standards. Ensure zero-harm field operations through permits, method statements, toolbox talks, PPE, and incident reporting. Follow and enforce all relevant Botanica and Red Sea Global Group policies, delegation of authority, processes, and standard operating procedures. Apply and champion the safety, quality, and environmental management systems (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001) and the compliance management system (ISO 37301). Identify and lead opportunities for continuous improvement in department systems, processes, and practices, focusing on cost reduction, productivity, and client value. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience. Work Context This role manages plant production for both internal Red Sea Global clients and external developments, where long growing cycles mean current decisions impact availability one to three years in advance. The position relies on Nursery Operations for water, soil, logistics, and equipment, requiring joint planning with the Director – Nursery Operations. Primary risks include plant losses from pests, disease, and heat, biosecurity incursions through imported stock, and changes in demand forecasts after growing has commenced. Application Information This is a full-time position. Salary details are not disclosed.

e2870aaafd0d19cf.description: مطلوب طباخ عربي. تعلن شركة صفوة الأعمال عن توفر فرصة عمل لطباخ عربي للعمل لدى فندق 4 نجوم في مدينة الرياض. المتطلبات: خبرة سابقة في المطاعم أو الفنادق. إجادة إعداد الأكلات العربية. الالتزام والنظافة وحسن المظهر. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. الأفضلية لمن لديه خبرة سابقة في فنادق 4 أو 5 نجوم. الموقع: الرياض – المملكة العربية السعودية الراتب: من 3,000 إلى 6,000 ريال سعودي، حسب الخبرة والكفاءة. العمل: دوام كامل. يرجى من المرشحين المناسبين التقديم وإرفاق السيرة الذاتية.

e2ece405f4cefd0f.description: About the Role كيلوج براون اند روت is seeking a Senior Planning Manager to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves providing PMO services, enterprise-level governance, assurance, integration, and performance oversight for a major infrastructure program. The project is a mixed-use development in Riyadh, aiming to be a global landmark recognized for its unique vision and position as an authentic destination, offering a distinct, self-sustaining hub with several iconic assets. Key Responsibilities Reporting to the Project Controls Director, the Senior Planning Manager is responsible for coordinating with PMCs on overall project planning, scheduling, and coordination. This includes defining, maintaining, and implementing requirements and standards for Primavera P6 usage, as well as: Defining, maintaining, and implementing the EPPM P6 EPS hierarchy and levels in compliance with the approved WBS, ensuring proper assignment for each node to relevant PMCs. Providing alignment between planning tools, PMIS (SharePoint), DWH, and all existing cost and reporting platforms. Coordinating schedule data integration and validation across systems. Supporting enhancements to planning and reporting tools consistent with digital transformation objectives. Managing the EPPM P6 Environment by maintaining P6 programs EPS nodes, IMS, and monthly archiving. Developing and maintaining a weightage system that supports progress measurement rollup for project, district, and program-level reporting, and maintaining an updated P6/EPS change log. Producing and updating the Master Procurement Schedule in accordance with the procurement strategy. Developing and maintaining program-level and portfolio-level Integrated Master Schedule (IMS). Verifying the entire program scope and site-wide packages are included within the IMS with communication upstream and downstream. Identifying and managing inter-project interfaces, dependencies, and critical paths. Verifying alignment between district-level and asset-level schedules. Supporting scenario analysis, sequencing options, and strategic planning inputs. Producing the IMS Baseline Package documents, including program narrative, basis of schedule, weightage distribution, cost loading breakdown, resource loading and resource leveling, codes, key interfaces and logistic constraints, assumptions and exclusions. Producing, maintaining, and regularly updating the IMS, including the Baseline BoD completion dates tracker, cash flow calculation and guidelines, resource calculation and guidelines, baseline Change Control Tracker, baseline records and version history, IMS Interface Tracker, program-level key issues, delay analysis, schedule alerts, and mitigation measures tracker. Ensuring the IMS schedule covers all project scope from initiation to closeout, including any related activities for design approvals, statutory approvals, infrastructure-related works, procurement activities, tenant fit-out, and exhibitions duration. Producing and issuing a monthly updated IMS pack reflecting the approved monthly progress cut-off date and reporting calendar, including consolidated portfolio/program-level IMS, Schedule Performance Analysis Report, Baseline and Change Impact Statement, Forecast and Mitigation Status Report, Interfaces and Dependency Log, updated KPIs report, updated IMS cashflow critical path(s) and near-critical path analysis, float consumption and trend analysis, schedule alert monitoring and reporting, updated resource profile Schedule Change Log, and version-controlled IMS tracker with clear revision history. Reporting upon the percent complete at the district, program, and portfolio levels based on the agreed weightage system. Developing and maintaining an overall, portfolio-level integrated ‘Development Master Schedule’ (DMS) that combines and aligns inputs, activities, and milestones from multiple stakeholders. Reporting upon DMS activities including Development Briefs and Feasibility Business Plan approvals, land acquisition and release dates, marketing activities and launch events, tenant fit-outs and exhibitions activities, sales strategies and events, budgeting, and cost information. Providing governance and oversight of PMC L3 Baseline schedules development and control by reviewing, validating, and approving PMC-developed schedules to validate compliance with planning standards and requirements. Verifying schedules are realistic and achievable, logic-driven, resource and cost loaded, and fully traceable. Reviewing and approving baseline schedules, including interim and recovery baselines. Managing baseline change control, including impact assessment, approvals, and documentation. Participating in monthly Program Review meetings. Leading the revised schedule baseline process. Reviewing PMC L3 updated schedules and verifying performance by defining standard progress measurement rules and methodologies. Reviewing PMC progress updates for accuracy, consistency, and substantiation. Validating reported progress against approved schedules and supporting evidence. Performing schedule performance analysis, including critical path, float consumption, and trend analysis. Identifying delays, risks, and emerging issues impacting schedule performance. Providing independent quality assurance of the PMC schedules by monitoring PMC compliance with planning and scheduling standards by conducting periodic schedule quality reviews and health checks. Verifying traceability, audit trails, and documentation for schedule decisions. Supporting internal and external audits related to schedule management. Supporting proactive forecast and recovery schedule management by reviewing and validating PMC forecasts and projected completion dates. Assessing the credibility of mitigation and recovery plans for delayed projects. Supporting the development and review of recovery schedules and acceleration options. Evaluating and escalating schedule risks and opportunities in coordination with risk management functions. Performing detailed schedule analysis of Level 4 Contractor Program to investigate issues related to progress and project status. Supporting long-term program maturity by capturing lessons learned and best practices in planning and scheduling, and supporting training, guidance, and mentoring for PMCs and internal teams. Qualifications and Requirements Minimum of 15 years of post-graduation experience. Professional memberships and charterships are required. Sound knowledge of all engineering, commercial, and planning aspects of major civil, infrastructure, and development projects. Experienced user of Primavera P6, Pertmaster, and MS Office. Excellent knowledge of CPM networks, resource and cost loading, and risk management techniques. Ability to effectively monitor and analyze progress, identify trends, and recommend corrective actions. Excellent report writing skills.

e2074bdf8bafe99a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة رتكو عن مشرف صيانة للانضمام إلى فريقها في مدينة الخرج. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان الجاهزية التشغيلية للمعدات والآلات من خلال الإشراف الفعال على أعمال الصيانة، وتقليل الأعطال والتوقفات، مع الالتزام بخطط الشركة ومعايير السلامة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف المباشر على جميع أعمال الصيانة الوقائية والتصحيحية للمعدات والآلات. ضمان جاهزية المعدات للتشغيل المستمر وتقليل فترات التوقف غير المخطط لها. متابعة أداء الفنيين وتوجيههم لضمان تنفيذ المهام بكفاءة. تنظيم أعمال الصيانة بما يتوافق مع الخطط والبرامج المعتمدة من الشركة. التأكد من تطبيق تعليمات وإجراءات السلامة المهنية في جميع مراحل الصيانة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 3 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال صيانة المعدات والآلات. فهم قوي لمبادئ الصيانة الوقائية والتصحيحية. القدرة على الإشراف وتوجيه فرق العمل الفنية. نوع الوظيفة ومكان العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الخرج. سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان استمرارية وكفاءة العمليات التشغيلية. المزايا المالية يتراوح الراتب الشهري لهذا الدور بين 5,625 ريال سعودي و 7,500 ريال سعودي، وذلك حسب الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة في شركة رتكو.

e220482d4cce1bfb.description: About the Role Kempinski Hotels is seeking a Front Office Manager to oversee the operations of the Reception, Concierge, PABX, and Business Center. This full-time position is based in Al Khobar, Eastern region, and requires ensuring the highest standards of service in accordance with operating procedures and Kempinski standards. Key Responsibilities Manage the Front Office Department within budgetary guidelines, including involvement in budget preparations and responsibility for profit & loss. Maximise hotel revenue by controlling room inventory, group blocking, packages, and up-selling, while adhering to late charge and double occupancy policies to maximise REVPAR. Prepare the annual budget and manning guide. Control duty rosters for sub-departments to guarantee quality and personnel cost efficiency. Oversee all labour cost controls within budget limits and occupancy variances to maximise productivity. Conduct interviews with prospective employees, identify training needs, and manage performance. Carry out disciplinary actions in line with company procedures. Re-evaluate workflows to improve and optimise organisation, and implement and evaluate procedures and policies. e22412086e0c2b57.description: About the Role Musco is seeking a Sales Representative for its Transportation & Infrastructure team in Dammam, Eastern Region, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves executing and managing the sales plan for a defined territory or project type, with the goal of meeting or exceeding sales and profitability targets. Develop and maintain strong communication networks and relationships with T&I customers, contractors, specifiers, and end-users. Present Musco's products and services effectively to customers through various channels such as sales presentations, meetings, field visits, and trade shows. Provide weekly and quarterly reports to Sales Management to ensure focus and travel efficiency. Communicate regularly with Sales Management and the Coordinator regarding territory needs, concerns, and resource allocation. Participate in corporate meetings/conference calls as required. Proficiency in both Arabic and English is mandatory. Ability and willingness to attend extended in-person training at the Corporate Headquarters in Oskaloosa, Iowa, United States. A proven track record of sales success with a technical product is required. Experience with reviewing AutoCAD, Project Plans, and Google Earth is preferred. Required Skills Self-directed with the ability to make informed decisions independently. Willingness to travel extensively (50%), primarily within KSA and the GCC. Working knowledge of MS Office, MS Teams, email, internet, and general PC and mobile device usage. Ability to learn, understand, and teach technical concepts and information. Ability to analyze and communicate bid and tender documents. Good organizational, customer service, and verbal and written communication skills. Work Environment This role is based in Musco's Dammam, Saudi Arabia office and operates on a full-time basis. The position requires significant travel within the region.

technology direction. · Develop and maintain the enterprise application architecture in alignment with business strategy and enterprise architecture direction. · Assess the current application landscape, including business applications, platforms, interfaces, dependencies, lifecycle status, and functional coverage. · Define target-state application architecture and transition roadmaps supporting business and digital transformation initiatives. · Map applications to business capabilities, business services, processes, data domains, and technology platforms. · Identify duplication, functional overlap, application gaps, technical debt, and rationalization opportunities across the application portfolio. · Support application modernization, replacement, consolidation, retirement, e27562c566694529.description: نبذة عن مجمع عيادات الموعد الطبية مجمع عيادات الموعد الطبية هو مؤسسة رائدة في تقديم الرعاية الصحية، ملتزمة بتقديم خدمات طبية عالية الجودة لمرضاها. يقع المجمع في مدينة الرياض، ويسعى لتعزيز فريقه بكفاءات تسهم في تحقيق أهدافه. نظرة عامة على وظيفة مأمور سنترال يبحث مجمع عيادات الموعد الطبية عن مأمور سنترال للانضمام إلى فريقه في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية الإشراف على عمليات تشغيل مقسمات الهاتف، وإدارة المكالمات الواردة والصادرة، بالإضافة إلى تسجيل الرسائل وتوجيهها. الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على تشغيل مقسمات الهاتف ولوحات تحويل الاتصالات ووحدات التحكم الخاصة بها، لضمان توصيل المكالمات الهاتفية وتعليقها وتحويلها وقطعها بكفاءة. الرد على المكالمات الواردة بمهنية، والترحيب بالمتصلين، وتقديم المعلومات اللازمة لهم، وتحويل المكالمات إلى الأقسام أو الأفراد المعنيين. تلقي الرسائل الموجهة إلى الموظفين أو العملاء وترحيلها حسب الحاجة، مع ضمان دقة المعلومات وسرعة التوصيل. متابعة حالة الأجهزة الهاتفية والمقسمات بشكل دوري، والتأكد من سرعة الإبلاغ عن أي أعطال في الأجهزة أو الهواتف أو الخطوط، والمساهمة في صيانتها بأسرع وقت ممكن. ضمان الالتزام التام بالأدلة الإجرائية والسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة للعمل والتقيد بها. رفع التقارير الفنية للإدارة حول سير العمل، وتوضيح الصعوبات والتحديات التي قد تعيق الأداء. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع أنظمة الاتصالات ومقسمات الهاتف. مهارات تواصل ممتازة ولباقة في التعامل مع المتصلين. القدرة على تنظيم المهام وتحديد الأولويات بفعالية. بيئة العمل تتمثل بيئة العمل في مجمع عيادات الموعد الطبية في الرياض، حيث يعمل مأمور السنترال ضمن فريق يدعم العمليات اليومية للمجمع. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب الالتزام بتقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة. التقديم للوظيفة ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقدم لهذه الوظيفة في مجمع عيادات الموعد الطبية بالرياض.
